beta_description: During the beta the Redline team verifies owners by hand, after a check outside the app. Until then your car stays Pending verification and gets no pings, no stats and no showcase. Automatic verification with a one-time code is coming soon.
verified_description: Spotters' Co-Driver can now recognise your car, and you get a ping every time it is collected.
expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
code_instructions: Write this code on paper or show it on another screen, put it behind the windscreen and photograph the car so the plate and the code are both readable.
